section_path: Hardware Setup > Rear Panel
question: What are the buttons and connections on the back of the CM2000, and what happens if I hold Reset?
answer: The rear panel has a Reset button, Ethernet port, coaxial cable port, and DC power connector. Holding Reset for at least seven seconds makes the Power LED blink white and returns the cable modem to factory settings.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Label
question: Where can I find the CM2000 login details and serial information?
answer: The label shows the modem login information, MAC address, and serial number.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Install and Activate Your Cable Modem > Connect Your Cable Modem to a Router After Installation and Activation
question: After my service is activated, how do I connect the CM2000 to my router?
answer: Reboot the modem and wait until the Internet LED is solid white. Connect the modem Ethernet port to the router WAN/Internet port, power on the router, wait until it is ready, and then connect a computer to the router.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Change the admin password
question: How can I change the CM2000 administrator password?
answer: Use a secure password of 6–32 characters with upper- and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Browse to 192.168.100.1, sign in as admin, then choose ADVANCED > Administration > Set Password, enter the old password and the new password twice, and click Apply.

section_path: Manage Your Network > View cable modem initialization
question: How do I know when the CM2000 has finished starting up?
answer: The modem scans and locks downstream frequency, ranges upstream channels, obtains a WAN address, and connects to the Internet. In the modem interface, open Cable Connection and read the Startup Procedure and channel status.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Reset the cable modem to factory default settings > Use the factory reset software button
question: How can I safely reset the CM2000 from its settings page?
answer: Sign in at 192.168.100.1, choose ADVANCED, click Factory reset, and confirm with OK. The configuration is erased and the modem reboots in about one minute; do not close the browser, load another page, or power off the modem while it resets.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Reset the cable modem to factory default settings > Use the reset button on the back panel
question: How can I reset the CM2000 using the button on the device?
answer: Locate the rear Reset button and hold it with a straightened paper clip until the modem reboots. The configuration returns to factory defaults and the process takes about one minute.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Cannot log in to the cable modem
question: I cannot sign in to the CM2000. What should I check first?
answer: Check the Ethernet connection, enable Java/JavaScript/ActiveX, restart or refresh the browser, use lowercase admin with Caps Lock off, and ensure the computer address is in 192.168.100.2–192.168.100.254. If changes do not persist, click Apply before leaving the page or refresh the browser.

section_path: Supplemental Information > Technical Specifications
question: What are the basic power, size, ports, and operating limits of the CM2000?
answer: The adapter accepts 110–120 V at 47–60 Hz and outputs 12 VDC at 1.5 A. The modem is 6.8 × 3.7 × 8.2 inches (172 × 94 × 208 mm), weighs 1.02 lb (482 g), has one 2.5 Gbps RJ-45 port and a DOCSIS 3.1 coaxial connector, supports the listed OFDM/SC-QAM and OFDMA channels, and operates at 32–104°F (0–40°C) with up to 90% noncondensing humidity.

section_path: Introduction and Hardware Overview > Install the Nano SIM Card
question: How do I put a SIM card into the LM1200?
answer: Obtain a nano SIM from the mobile provider, turn the modem off, place it horizontally with the bottom facing you, and gently insert the card into the SIM slot.

section_path: Get Started > Connect a Computer, Switch, Hub, Router, or WiFi Router to the Modem > Connect a Computer to the LAN Port of the Modem
question: How do I connect one computer to the LM1200 with a network cable?
answer: Connect one end of the supplied Ethernet cable to the computer Ethernet port and the other end to the modem Gigabit Ethernet LAN port on the back panel.

section_path: Manage the Modem LAN Settings > Change the DHCP Server Settings
question: How can I change the network settings that the LM1200 gives to my devices?
answer: Sign in at 192.168.5.1, open Settings > Advanced > LAN, keep DHCP Server enabled, enter the start and end addresses in DHCP IP Range, optionally change the lease time, select Manual DNS to enter DNS 1 and DNS 2, and click Submit. The modem resets and connected devices must obtain new addresses.

section_path: Manage the Mobile Broadband Connection > Manually Connect to or Disconnect From the Mobile Broadband Network
question: How can I manually connect or disconnect the LM1200 from the mobile network?
answer: Disable Auto Connect first, sign in to 192.168.5.1, and click Connect or Disconnect on the dashboard. Wait for the dashboard to display again after the modem attempts the requested action.

section_path: Secure Your Network > Manage Port Forwarding for Incoming Traffic > Remove a Service or Application for Port Forwarding
question: How do I remove a connection rule that I no longer need on the LM1200?
answer: Sign in at 192.168.5.1, select Settings > Advanced > Port Forwarding, and click the x beside the service or application. It is removed immediately; Submit is not required.

section_path: Secure Your Network > Manage SIM Card Security > Disable SIM Card Security
question: What should I know before turning off SIM security on the LM1200?
answer: Repeated incorrect SIM PIN entries can block the card; the allowed attempts depend on the SIM. In that case the provider must supply a PUK. After disabling SIM security with the correct PIN, the modem no longer asks for a SIM PIN when it connects.

section_path: Manage the Modem and Monitor Usage and the Network > View Monthly Data and Session Data Usage
question: What do the monthly and current-session data numbers on the LM1200 mean?
answer: Monthly usage measures data from the billing-cycle start and resets automatically at the next cycle. Session usage measures data and elapsed time for the current connection and resets for each session; the session section appears only while connected.

section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > How do I access the modem’s web pages?
question: Where can I find the instructions for opening the LM1200 settings?
answer: The manual directs you to the section Access the Modem’s Web Pages for the First Time on page 19.

section_path: Alerts and Troubleshooting > Quick Tips for Troubleshooting
question: The LM1200 will not connect. What should I check for mobile and cable connections?
answer: For mobile broadband, verify coverage and an active account, reseat the SIM, and unlock it with the correct PIN if SIM security is enabled. For Ethernet, check the cable and make sure the computer obtains its address automatically with DHCP rather than using a static address.

section_path: Alerts and Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot the Mobile Broadband Internet Connection > Obtain an Internet IP Address From Your Service Provider
question: Why does the LM1200 show that it has no internet address, and what can I do?
answer: It means the modem did not obtain an Internet IP address from the provider. Check that an APN profile exists, power-cycle the modem, and contact the mobile provider if an address still cannot be obtained.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manually set up the Internet connection > Specify an Internet connection that uses a login and PPPoE service
question: How do I set up an R6350 internet connection that needs a provider username and password?
answer: Open routerlogin.net, select Internet, choose Yes for a login and PPPoE as the encapsulation, enter the ISP login and password, provide a service name if required, select the connection mode, IP and DNS options, choose the MAC address option, click Apply, and then Test the connection.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Set up an IPv6 6to4 tunnel Internet connection
question: What needs to be ready before I use the R6350 with an IPv6 tunnel?
answer: The IPv4 Internet connection must work first. In ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > IPv6 choose 6to4 Tunnel, then use an automatically selected relay or enter the static IPv4 address supplied by the IPv6 provider; finish the DNS and address-assignment settings and apply them.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage the MTU size > Change the MTU size
question: Could changing the R6350 connection-size setting stop some websites from opening?
answer: An incorrect MTU can prevent access to websites, secure login pages, or FTP/POP servers, so change it only when necessary. In WAN Setup enter 64–1500; typical values are 1500 for Ethernet, 1492 for PPPoE, and 1436 for PPTP.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Manage Default and Custom QoS Rules > Remove a QoS Rule
question: How do I remove a speed-priority rule on the R6350?
answer: Sign in at routerlogin.net, select ADVANCED > Setup > QoS Setup, select the service, application, or device in the QoS table, click Delete, and click Apply.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Manage Access to a Storage Device
question: What can I do with a USB drive connected to the R6350?
answer: In ReadySHARE you can set the device and workgroup names and enable or disable Network Connection, HTTP, HTTPS via the Internet, FTP, and FTP via the Internet. Each method has documented default ports and password-protection options.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Edit a network folder on a USB storage device
question: How do I change a folder that I share from a USB drive?
answer: Open ADVANCED > USB Storage > ReadySHARE, select the USB device under Available Network Folders, click Edit, change the fields, and click Apply.

section_path: Manage the WAN and LAN Network Settings > Manage VPN Pass-Through
question: What does VPN pass-through do on the R6350?
answer: It lets a LAN computer receive Internet VPN traffic over IPSec, PPTP, or L2TP. It is enabled by default; disabling a protocol blocks its VPN pass-through traffic.

section_path: Manage the WAN and LAN Network Settings > Set Up a Bridge for a Port Group or VLAN Tag Group > Set Up a Bridge for a Port Group
question: Why might my TV device need a special bridge setting on the R6350?
answer: An ISP may require the bridge when an IPTV device is connected. The bridge prevents packets between the IPTV device and the Internet port from being processed by the router’s NAT service.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Update the router firmware > Check for new firmware and update the router
question: How do I safely check for and install updates on the R6350?
answer: Use an Ethernet-connected computer, sign in at routerlogin.net, open ADVANCED > Administration > Firmware Update, click Check, download and install an available update, and follow the confirmation. The wired connection is recommended during the update.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Disable or Enable LED Blinking or Turn Off LEDs
question: Can I change how the lights blink on the R6350?
answer: LED Control Settings can keep normal blinking when traffic is detected, disable traffic blinking, or turn off every LED except the Power LED. The setting is changed under ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > LED Control Settings.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN software > Install OpenVPN Software on an Android Device
question: How can I use the R6350 VPN service on an Android phone?
answer: Enable VPN Service in ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > VPN Service, download the smartphone configuration files, install OpenVPN Connect from Google Play, unzip the files on a computer, and send or copy them to the Android device for import.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot Internet browsing
question: The R6350 says it is connected, but websites will not open. What should I check?
answer: The traffic-meter limit may be blocking access, the computer may lack DNS addresses, or the router may not be the default gateway. Check the traffic-meter setting, restart or configure DNS on the computer, and verify the router address is its gateway.

section_path: Connect to the Network and Access the Router > Connect to the Network > Wired Connection
question: What happens when I plug a computer into the R7000 with a network cable?
answer: With the router powered, connect an Ethernet cable from the computer to a router Ethernet port. The computer then joins the router’s local area network.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Use the Internet Setup Wizard
question: How can I let the R7000 set up my internet connection automatically?
answer: Sign in at routerlogin.net, choose ADVANCED > Setup Wizard, select Yes, and click Next. The wizard searches for servers and protocols to determine the Internet configuration.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Optimize Internet Streaming With Dynamic QoS > Enable Advanced QoS and Manually Set Up QoS Rules > Add a QoS Rule by LAN pot
question: How can I give one device or cable connection priority when the network is busy?
answer: Open QoS, enable QoS and Advanced QoS, choose QoS by LAN Port, name the policy, select the Ethernet LAN port and a device priority, click Add, and then Apply.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Improve Network Connections With Universal Plug-N-Play
question: What does UPnP do for devices and games on the R7000?
answer: Universal Plug-and-Play lets network devices discover services from registered UPnP devices and configure connections automatically. It is useful for multiplayer games, peer-to-peer connections, and real-time communications.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Check the Internet Connection Status
question: Where can I see the R7000's current internet connection details?
answer: The window shows the router IP address, subnet mask, default gateway, DHCP server, DNS server, and other Internet-port status values listed by the manual.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Remote Access > Set Up Remote Management
question: How can I reach the R7000 from outside my home while limiting who can connect?
answer: Under ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Remote Management, turn it on and restrict Allow Remote Access By to only the necessary external IP address or range. The manual recommends allowing as few addresses as practical.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Change the NTP Server
question: How can I change the time service used by the R7000?
answer: Open ADVANCED > Administration > NTP Settings, select Set your preferred NTP server, enter the primary server domain or IP address, and click Apply.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet
question: How can I reach files on a USB drive connected to the R7000 while away from home?
answer: From a remote computer, connect using the router’s Dynamic DNS name or its Internet-port IP address. Dynamic DNS requires account information on the Dynamic DNS page; FTP can then be used to share files.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Remotely Access a USB Device Using ReadyCLOUD > Create a ReadyCLOUD Account
question: How do I create a ReadyCLOUD account for the R7000?
answer: Open a browser, visit the ReadyCLOUD address, click Sign In and then Create Account, complete the MyNETGEAR account fields, and click Create. The router can then be registered with that account.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN Software > Install OpenVPN Software on an iOS Device
question: How can I use the R7000 VPN service on an iPhone or iPad?
answer: Enable VPN Service, download the smartphone configuration files from the router, install OpenVPN Connect from the Apple App Store, unzip the files on a computer, and send them to the iOS device for import.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick Tips > Sequence to Restart Your Network
question: What is the correct order for restarting my modem and R7000?
answer: Turn off and unplug the modem, turn off the router, plug in and power on the modem and wait two minutes, then turn on the router and wait another two minutes.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot WiFi Connectivity
question: My R7000 Wi-Fi is weak or missing. What should I check?
answer: Check the WiFi LED and radio button, whether SSID broadcast hides the network, and whether the device supports the selected WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security. For weak signal, use Ethernet to inspect settings and place the device near—but at least six feet from—the router, away from obstructions.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Unpack your router
question: What should be included in the RAX120 box?
answer: The package contains the router, its power adapter, and an Ethernet cable.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Types of logins
question: Which password is for my internet, Wi-Fi, NETGEAR account, and router settings?
answer: The ISP login accesses the Internet service; the WiFi key accesses the wireless network; the NETGEAR account registers the router and manages subscriptions; and the router login password opens the router administration pages.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Set up an IPv6 pass-through Internet connection
question: What does IPv6 pass-through do on the RAX120?
answer: In ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > IPv6, select Pass Through and click Apply. The router then acts as a Layer 2 Ethernet switch for IPv6 packets and does not process their IPv6 headers.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > View or change the WAN settings
question: Which internet-side settings on the RAX120 need extra care?
answer: WAN Setup includes DoS/port-scan protection, a default DMZ server, WAN ping response, IGMP proxying, MTU, NAT filtering, and SIP ALG. A DMZ weakens firewall security, WAN ping should be enabled only for a diagnostic reason, and MTU should be changed only when necessary.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Manage reserved LAN IP addresses > Reserve an IP address
question: How can I make a device keep the same local network address on the RAX120?
answer: Open ADVANCED > Setup > LAN Setup, click Add under Address Reservation, enter an address from the LAN subnet and the device MAC address, and click Apply. The reservation takes effect when the device next contacts DHCP; reboot or renew its lease to force that.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Change the WiFi password or the WiFi security
question: What is the difference between the RAX120 Wi-Fi password and administrator password?
answer: The WiFi password is separate from the router admin password. The router supports WPA2-Personal, mixed WPA/WPA2, WPA/WPA2 Enterprise with a RADIUS server, and WPA3-Personal; an 8–63-character network key is required for the personal modes, and open security is discouraged.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Connect a USB storage device to the router
question: What should I know before plugging a USB drive into the RAX120?
answer: Insert the storage device into a router USB port and connect its own power supply when it has one. A device can take up to two minutes to become shareable, special-driver devices are incompatible, and the default is access for all computers on the LAN.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Add a network folder on a USB storage device
question: How do I share a folder from a USB drive on the RAX120?
answer: Open ADVANCED > ReadySHARE > Advanced Settings, choose the USB device, select Create Network Folder, set the share name and read/write access, then Apply and Close Window.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Set up and manage Dynamic DNS > Change the Dynamic DNS settings
question: How can I change the RAX120 Dynamic DNS account settings?
answer: Sign in at routerlogin.net, open ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Dynamic DNS, change the account settings, and click Apply.

section_path: Manage port forwarding and port triggering > Manage port forwarding to a local server > How the router implements the port forwarding rule
question: When someone opens a website, how does the RAX120 send the request to the right device?
answer: The router matches the port-forwarding rule, sends the request to the local server, and applies NAT when the reply goes back to the internet.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot WiFi connectivity
question: My device cannot join RAX120 Wi-Fi. What should I check?
answer: Check the Wi-Fi light and button, whether the network name is hidden, whether the device supports the selected security, and whether distance or obstacles weaken the signal.

section_path: Supplemental Information > Factory settings
question: What changes after I return the RAX120 to its original factory settings?
answer: A factory reset removes user settings, restores the default LAN and Wi-Fi values, and restarts the router. Do not interrupt the process.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Position your router
question: Why might moving the RAX50 change the Wi-Fi range?
answer: Walls, metal, glass, mirrors, appliances, nearby access points, and a low or poorly placed router can reduce Wi-Fi range.

section_path: Connect to the Network and Access the Router > Connect to the router network > Connect to the router WiFi network
question: How do I connect a phone or computer to RAX50 Wi-Fi?
answer: Turn on the router, open Wi-Fi settings on the phone or computer, choose the SSID printed on the router label, and enter its network key.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Use auto config for an IPv6 Internet connection
question: How does the RAX50 set up IPv6 automatically?
answer: Choose Auto Config under IPv6. The router detects the WAN/LAN addresses, after which you can set provider, DNS, address, and filtering options.

section_path: Control Access to the Internet > Network access control list > Manage allowed devices currently not on the network
question: How can I allow or block a device on the RAX50?
answer: In Security > Access Control, add a device by its MAC address, remove it, or edit it to allow or block access, then Apply.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Use Dynamic QoS to optimize Internet traffic management > Enable Dynamic QoS
question: How can I make the RAX50 share internet fairly when some devices use a lot?
answer: Enable QoS and let Speedtest detect the bandwidth, or enter download and upload speeds yourself, then Apply.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Use Dynamic QoS to optimize Internet traffic management > Manually update the dynamic QoS database
question: How do I update the RAX50 information used to control traffic?
answer: Open the QoS page, keep Dynamic QoS enabled if needed, choose Update Now, and Apply after the update finishes.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Manage the router configuration file > Erase the settings
question: What happens if I erase the RAX50 settings?
answer: Erase removes user settings, restores factory defaults, and restarts the router in about two minutes. Do not close the browser or turn it off.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > About VPN connections
question: What can the RAX50 VPN service do, and what can it not do?
answer: OpenVPN creates an encrypted tunnel so a laptop can reach the home network from outside. The router is not a VPN client for encrypting all home-to-internet traffic.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Block VPN client Internet access in the router
question: How do I let RAX50 VPN users reach only my home network?
answer: Enable VPN Service, choose Home Network only for client access, and Apply. This prevents VPN users from using the home internet connection.

section_path: Manage Port Forwarding and Port Triggering > Manage port forwarding to a local server > Delete a port forwarding entry
question: How do I remove an old connection rule on the RAX50?
answer: Open Port Forwarding/Port Triggering, select the old service in the table, and choose Delete Service.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot your network using the ping utility > Test the path from a Windows-based computer to a remote device
question: How can I test whether the RAX50 can reach another address?
answer: From Windows Run, send several ping requests to the remote address. If there is no reply, check the gateway, network address, modem, ISP host name, and MAC settings.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Connect to the network > Find and connect to the WiFi network
question: How do I find and join my RAXE500 Wi-Fi?
answer: Turn on the router, open Wi-Fi settings, select the SSID printed on its label, and enter the password printed there.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Use a web browser to access the router > Automatic Internet Setup
question: The RAXE500 setup page does not appear or automatic setup fails. What should I try?
answer: Check the LAN/Wi-Fi connection and Power LED, reopen the browser or clear its cache, and make sure the computer obtains an address automatically.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage the MTU size > MTU concepts
question: What does the RAXE500 connection-size setting affect?
answer: A smaller maximum packet size can cause fragmentation. Common values depend on the connection, so keep the default unless support says to change it.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Disable the DHCP server feature in the router
question: How can I safely turn off the RAXE500 service that automatically gives devices addresses?
answer: In LAN Setup, clear Use Router as DHCP Server and Apply only after confirming that another DHCP server exists or that you can set a computer address manually.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Enable or disable 20/40 MHz coexistence for the 2.4 GHz radio
question: Can the RAXE500 reduce interference from nearby Wi-Fi, and what is the trade-off?
answer: Coexistence can reduce interference by allowing narrower channels, but it may lower speed. The option affects 2.4 GHz, not 5 GHz.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Manage Ethernet Port Aggregation to a LAN Device > View or Change the Router Ethernet Port Aggregation Mode
question: What are the choices for combining two RAXE500 network ports?
answer: Disable keeps the two ports separate, LACP combines them when supported, and Static is for equipment that specifically supports a static link aggregation group.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Monitor Internet traffic
question: How can I set a data-use limit or warning on the RAXE500?
answer: Enable Traffic Meter, set a volume or time limit and warning, and choose whether the internet light blinks or the connection stops at the limit.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Set your time zone
question: How do I set the time zone and daylight-saving option on the RAXE500?
answer: Open NTP Settings, choose the time zone, enable daylight saving when needed, and Apply.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Add a network folder on a USB storage device
question: How do I share a folder from a USB drive on the RAXE500?
answer: Choose the USB device in ReadySHARE Storage, create a network folder, and set read/write access. The default allows all LAN computers without a password.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Set up VPN client Internet access in the router
question: How can a VPN user on the RAXE500 also use my home internet?
answer: Enable VPN Service and choose All sites on the Internet & Home Network. Internet traffic through the home VPN may be slower than local access.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick tips > Sequence to restart your network
question: What is the right order for restarting the RAXE500 network?
answer: Turn off and unplug the modem, turn off the router, start the modem and wait two minutes, then start the router and wait two more minutes.

section_path: Overview > Sync your Orbi satellite with your Orbi router
question: What do the satellite light colors mean on the RBK852?
answer: Blue means the satellite is well connected, amber means it should be closer, and magenta means it needs to be moved closer and synced again.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage an IPv6 Internet connection > Specify IPv6 Internet connections
question: How can I choose the right IPv6 connection type on the RBK852?
answer: Open IPv6 and choose Auto Detect when unsure. Other choices include Auto Config, DHCP, fixed, PPPoE, 6to4, 6rd, and pass-through.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage an IPv6 Internet connection > Set up an IPv6 PPPoE Internet connection
question: How do I set up an IPv6 connection that uses my provider login on the RBK852?
answer: Choose IPv6 PPPoE, enter the provider login and optional service name, set DNS/address options, and Apply. Always On reconnects after a drop.

section_path: Control Access to the Internet > Set up security event email notifications
question: How can the RBK852 email me about security events?
answer: Enable email notification, enter the email and SMTP details, choose immediate or scheduled alerts, and Apply. Missing email/SMTP values prevent notifications.

section_path: Specify Network Settings > Manage the WAN preference for Orbi router model RBR860 > Set up Internet port aggregation for Orbi router model RBR860
question: What do I need to connect two links between the modem and RBR860?
answer: The modem must support LACP. Enable WAN aggregation and connect the router's 10G and port 1 links to two modem ports.

section_path: Specify Network Settings > Manage custom static routes > Set up a static route
question: How can I tell the RBK852 to send traffic to another local network?
answer: Add a static route with its destination network, mask, and gateway. The gateway must be on the same LAN segment; a single host uses a /32 mask.

section_path: Mantain and Monitor Your Network > Check your Internet bandwidth
question: How do I check my internet speed from the RBK852?
answer: Open orbilogin.com, choose Speedtest, and select Take a Speedtest to see download and upload speeds.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Block VPN client Internet access in the router
question: How do I stop a VPN user on the RBK852 from using my home internet?
answer: Enable VPN Service, choose Home Network only for clients, and Apply. This keeps VPN clients from using the home internet service.

section_path: Customize Internet Traffic Rules for Ports > Manage port forwarding to a local server > Set up port forwarding to a local server
question: How can I let an outside connection reach a server inside my RBK852 network?
answer: Give the server a stable local address, create a port-forwarding service with its port and protocol, and Apply.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick tips > Sequence to restart your network
question: What is the proper restart order for the RBK852?
answer: Turn off and unplug the modem, turn off the router, start the modem and wait two minutes, then start the router and wait two more minutes.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot your network using the ping utility > Test the path from your computer to a remote device
question: How can I test the path from my computer through the RBK852 to another address?
answer: Run several ping requests from Windows after checking the LAN path. If they fail, check the gateway, network, modem, ISP host name, and MAC settings.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Unpack your router
question: What comes in the XR500 package?
answer: The package contains the XR500 router, four antennas, its power adapter, and an Ethernet cable.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manually set up the Internet connection > Specify an Internet connection without a login
question: How do I set up the XR500 when my provider does not require a login?
answer: Open Internet Setup, leave the provider-login option set to No, enter any required account or host information, choose IP/DNS/MAC settings, and Apply then test.

section_path: Customize Quality of Service Settings and Optimize Gaming > Manage bandwidth allocation > Prevent network congestion with Anti-Bufferbloat
question: How does the XR500 help when one device uses too much internet?
answer: Anti-Bufferbloat limits the share of total bandwidth used by heavy devices so other devices have bandwidth and less delay.

section_path: Customize Quality of Service Settings and Optimize Gaming > Manage traffic prioritization > Prioritize traffic for a device and view prioritization information
question: How does the XR500 help reduce lag when the network is busy?
answer: Traffic prioritization places selected device or service traffic at the front of the queue to reduce lag when the network is busy.

section_path: Manage the Router’s Network Settings > Manage reserved LAN IP addresses > Change a reserved IP address
question: How can I change a reserved local address on the XR500?
answer: Select the reserved-address entry, edit it, Apply on Address Reservation, and Apply again on LAN Setup.

section_path: Manage the Router’s WiFi Settings > Configure WPA/WPA2 enterprise WiFi security
question: What do I need for business-style Wi-Fi security on the XR500?
answer: Enterprise Wi-Fi security requires access to a RADIUS server. Use a wired connection while changing the main Wi-Fi settings.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Approve USB devices
question: How can I allow only approved USB devices on the XR500?
answer: Open USB Settings, choose Approved Devices, select a device from the available list, and confirm the change.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB storage devices through the Internet > Set up FTP access through the Internet
question: How do I share USB storage over the internet from the XR500?
answer: Enable FTP via internet in ReadySHARE Storage, then edit the USB share and limit read/write access to admin if desired.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB storage devices through the Internet > Use FTP to access storage devices through the Internet
question: How can I access XR500 USB files from another computer?
answer: Set up FTP over the internet, then use a browser or FTP client with the router's internet address or DDNS name and an allowed account.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN software on a VPN client > Install OpenVPN software on an Android device
question: How can I use the XR500 VPN service on Android?
answer: Install OpenVPN Connect from Google Play, enable VPN Service on the router, download the smartphone configuration, and import it into Android.

section_path: Use VPN to Access An External Network > Enable the VPN client in the router and connect to a VPN server
question: What do I need before using the XR500 with a commercial VPN?
answer: The router has a defined provider, but a commercial VPN may require that provider's license. Enable VPN Client and enter the requested credentials.

section_path: Manage and Customize Internet Traffic Rules for Ports > Manage port triggering for services and applications > Add a port triggering service or application
question: How do I make a game or app work through the XR500?
answer: Create a port-triggering rule for the game or app, choose its protocol and ports, and save the service.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Rear Panel
question: Apa saja tombol dan sambungan di belakang CM2000, dan apa yang terjadi jika Reset ditahan?
answer: Panel belakang memiliki tombol Reset, port Ethernet, port kabel koaksial, dan konektor daya. Menahan Reset minimal tujuh detik membuat LED Power berkedip putih dan mengembalikan modem ke setelan pabrik.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Label
question: Di mana saya bisa menemukan informasi login dan nomor seri CM2000?
answer: Label mencantumkan informasi login modem, alamat MAC, dan nomor seri.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Install and Activate Your Cable Modem > Connect Your Cable Modem to a Router After Installation and Activation
question: Setelah layanan aktif, bagaimana cara menghubungkan CM2000 ke router saya?
answer: Nyalakan ulang modem dan tunggu LED Internet menyala putih tetap. Hubungkan port Ethernet modem ke port WAN/Internet router, nyalakan router, lalu sambungkan komputer ke router.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Change the admin password
question: Bagaimana cara mengganti kata sandi administrator CM2000?
answer: Gunakan kata sandi aman 6–32 karakter berisi huruf besar-kecil, angka, dan simbol. Buka 192.168.100.1, masuk sebagai admin, pilih ADVANCED > Administration > Set Password, masukkan kata sandi lama dan baru, lalu Apply.

section_path: Manage Your Network > View cable modem initialization
question: Bagaimana saya tahu bahwa CM2000 sudah selesai menyala?
answer: Modem memindai frekuensi, menyiapkan kanal, mendapatkan alamat WAN, lalu tersambung ke internet. Statusnya dapat dilihat di Cable Connection pada bagian Startup Procedure dan channel.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Reset the cable modem to factory default settings > Use the factory reset software button
question: Bagaimana cara mengembalikan CM2000 ke setelan awal dari halaman pengaturannya?
answer: Masuk ke 192.168.100.1, pilih ADVANCED > Factory reset, lalu konfirmasi OK. Konfigurasi dihapus dan modem menyala ulang sekitar satu menit; jangan menutup browser atau mematikan modem.

section_path: Manage Your Network > Reset the cable modem to factory default settings > Use the reset button on the back panel
question: Bagaimana cara mereset CM2000 memakai tombol pada perangkat?
answer: Tekan tombol Reset di belakang dengan penjepit kertas sampai modem menyala ulang. Setelan kembali ke pabrik dan prosesnya sekitar satu menit.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Cannot log in to the cable modem
question: Saya tidak bisa masuk ke CM2000. Apa yang perlu diperiksa lebih dulu?
answer: Periksa kabel Ethernet, browser, huruf kecil pada admin, Caps Lock, dan alamat komputer. Klik Apply agar perubahan tersimpan.

section_path: Supplemental Information > Technical Specifications
question: Apa spesifikasi dasar daya, ukuran, port, dan batas penggunaan CM2000?
answer: Adaptor menerima 110–120 V dan menghasilkan 12 VDC/1,5 A. Modem berukuran 6,8 × 3,7 × 8,2 inci, berbobot 1,02 lb, memiliki port 2,5 Gbps dan konektor koaksial, serta bekerja pada 0–40°C.

section_path: Introduction and Hardware Overview > Install the Nano SIM Card
question: Bagaimana cara memasukkan kartu SIM ke LM1200?
answer: Dapatkan nano-SIM dari provider, matikan modem, posisikan sesuai petunjuk, lalu masukkan kartu perlahan ke slot SIM.

section_path: Get Started > Connect a Computer, Switch, Hub, Router, or WiFi Router to the Modem > Connect a Computer to the LAN Port of the Modem
question: Bagaimana cara menghubungkan satu komputer ke LM1200 dengan kabel jaringan?
answer: Hubungkan kabel Ethernet yang disertakan dari port Ethernet komputer ke port LAN Gigabit di bagian belakang modem.

section_path: Manage the Modem LAN Settings > Change the DHCP Server Settings
question: Bagaimana cara mengubah pengaturan jaringan yang dibagikan LM1200 ke perangkat saya?
answer: Masuk ke 192.168.5.1, buka Settings > Advanced > LAN, ubah rentang alamat dan DNS, lalu Submit. Modem akan menyala ulang dan perangkat perlu mendapat alamat baru.

section_path: Manage the Mobile Broadband Connection > Manually Connect to or Disconnect From the Mobile Broadband Network
question: Bagaimana cara menyambungkan atau memutuskan LM1200 dari jaringan seluler secara manual?
answer: Matikan Auto Connect, masuk ke 192.168.5.1, lalu pilih Connect atau Disconnect pada dashboard dan tunggu hasilnya.

section_path: Secure Your Network > Manage Port Forwarding for Incoming Traffic > Remove a Service or Application for Port Forwarding
question: Bagaimana cara menghapus aturan koneksi yang sudah tidak saya perlukan di LM1200?
answer: Masuk ke Settings > Advanced > Port Forwarding, lalu tekan tanda x di samping layanan yang ingin dihapus.

section_path: Secure Your Network > Manage SIM Card Security > Disable SIM Card Security
question: Apa yang perlu saya ketahui sebelum mematikan keamanan SIM di LM1200?
answer: Terlalu banyak PIN SIM yang salah dapat memblokir kartu dan memerlukan PUK dari provider. Setelah keamanan dimatikan dengan PIN benar, modem tidak lagi meminta PIN SIM saat tersambung.

section_path: Manage the Modem and Monitor Usage and the Network > View Monthly Data and Session Data Usage
question: Apa arti angka pemakaian data bulanan dan sesi saat ini di LM1200?
answer: Pemakaian bulanan dihitung sejak awal siklus tagihan dan direset pada siklus berikutnya. Pemakaian sesi menghitung koneksi saat ini dan direset setiap sesi.

section_path: Frequently Asked Questions > How do I access the modem’s web pages?
question: Di mana petunjuk untuk membuka pengaturan LM1200?
answer: Petunjuknya ada pada bagian Access the Modem’s Web Pages for the First Time, halaman 19.

section_path: Alerts and Troubleshooting > Quick Tips for Troubleshooting
question: LM1200 tidak mau tersambung. Apa yang perlu diperiksa untuk koneksi seluler dan kabel?
answer: Untuk seluler, periksa jangkauan, akun, posisi SIM, dan PIN. Untuk kabel, periksa kabel dan pastikan komputer memperoleh alamat otomatis.

section_path: Alerts and Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot the Mobile Broadband Internet Connection > Obtain an Internet IP Address From Your Service Provider
question: Mengapa LM1200 tidak mendapat alamat internet, dan apa yang bisa saya lakukan?
answer: Alamat 0.0.0.0 berarti modem belum memperoleh alamat internet dari provider. Periksa profil APN, nyalakan ulang modem, dan hubungi provider bila tetap gagal.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manually set up the Internet connection > Specify an Internet connection that uses a login and PPPoE service
question: Bagaimana cara mengatur koneksi internet R6350 yang memerlukan nama pengguna dan kata sandi dari provider?
answer: Buka routerlogin.net, pilih Internet dan opsi login PPPoE, masukkan username/password provider, lalu Apply dan Test.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Set up an IPv6 6to4 tunnel Internet connection
question: Apa yang harus siap sebelum R6350 digunakan dengan koneksi IPv6?
answer: Koneksi IPv4 harus sudah berfungsi. Pada pengaturan IPv6, pilih 6to4 Tunnel dan gunakan relay otomatis atau alamat yang diberikan provider.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage the MTU size > Change the MTU size
question: Apakah mengubah ukuran paket koneksi R6350 bisa membuat beberapa situs tidak terbuka?
answer: Nilai yang salah dapat membuat situs, login aman, atau FTP tidak terbuka. Ubah hanya bila perlu dan gunakan nilai 64–1500 sesuai koneksi.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Manage Default and Custom QoS Rules > Remove a QoS Rule
question: Bagaimana cara menghapus aturan prioritas kecepatan di R6350?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Setup > QoS Setup, pilih aturan pada tabel, tekan Delete, lalu Apply.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Manage Access to a Storage Device
question: Apa saja yang bisa dilakukan dengan flash disk USB yang terhubung ke R6350?
answer: ReadySHARE dapat mengatur nama perangkat/workgroup dan akses jaringan, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, termasuk akses dari internet dan perlindungan kata sandi.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Edit a network folder on a USB storage device
question: Bagaimana cara mengubah folder yang dibagikan dari flash disk USB?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > USB Storage > ReadySHARE, pilih folder pada perangkat USB, tekan Edit, ubah isinya, lalu Apply.

section_path: Manage the WAN and LAN Network Settings > Manage VPN Pass-Through
question: Apa fungsi VPN pass-through di R6350?
answer: VPN pass-through memungkinkan komputer di rumah menerima lalu lintas VPN dari internet. Fitur ini aktif secara default dan tiap protokol bisa dimatikan.

section_path: Manage the WAN and LAN Network Settings > Set Up a Bridge for a Port Group or VLAN Tag Group > Set Up a Bridge for a Port Group
question: Mengapa perangkat TV saya mungkin membutuhkan pengaturan bridge khusus di R6350?
answer: Provider internet mungkin meminta bridge khusus saat perangkat IPTV terhubung agar lalu lintasnya tidak diproses NAT router.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Update the router firmware > Check for new firmware and update the router
question: Bagaimana cara memeriksa dan memasang pembaruan R6350 dengan aman?
answer: Gunakan komputer berkabel, masuk ke routerlogin.net, buka Firmware Update, tekan Check, lalu pasang pembaruan yang tersedia.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Disable or Enable LED Blinking or Turn Off LEDs
question: Apakah saya bisa mengubah cara lampu indikator R6350 berkedip?
answer: LED Control Settings dapat mempertahankan kedipan normal, mematikan kedipan lalu lintas, atau mematikan semua LED selain Power.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN software > Install OpenVPN Software on an Android Device
question: Bagaimana cara memakai layanan VPN R6350 di ponsel Android?
answer: Aktifkan VPN Service, unduh konfigurasi ponsel, pasang OpenVPN Connect dari Google Play, lalu impor berkas konfigurasi ke Android.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot Internet browsing
question: R6350 terlihat tersambung, tetapi situs web tidak terbuka. Apa yang harus diperiksa?
answer: Periksa traffic meter, DNS komputer, dan alamat router sebagai gateway. Salah satu dari ketiganya dapat membuat situs tidak terbuka.

section_path: Connect to the Network and Access the Router > Connect to the Network > Wired Connection
question: Apa yang terjadi ketika komputer disambungkan ke R7000 dengan kabel jaringan?
answer: Ketika kabel Ethernet disambungkan dari komputer ke port router, komputer masuk ke jaringan lokal router.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Use the Internet Setup Wizard
question: Bagaimana cara membiarkan R7000 mengatur koneksi internet secara otomatis?
answer: Masuk ke routerlogin.net, buka ADVANCED > Setup Wizard, pilih Yes dan Next. Wizard akan mencari pengaturan internet yang sesuai.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Optimize Internet Streaming With Dynamic QoS > Enable Advanced QoS and Manually Set Up QoS Rules > Add a QoS Rule by LAN pot
question: Bagaimana cara memberi prioritas kepada satu perangkat atau sambungan kabel saat jaringan sibuk?
answer: Aktifkan QoS, pilih QoS by LAN Port, buat kebijakan, pilih port dan prioritas perangkat, lalu Add dan Apply.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Improve Network Connections With Universal Plug-N-Play
question: Apa fungsi UPnP untuk perangkat dan game di R7000?
answer: UPnP memungkinkan perangkat menemukan layanan dan membuka koneksi otomatis. Fitur ini berguna untuk game online dan komunikasi real-time.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Check the Internet Connection Status
question: Di mana saya bisa melihat informasi koneksi internet R7000 saat ini?
answer: Jendela status menampilkan alamat IP router, subnet mask, gateway, server DHCP/DNS, dan status port internet lainnya.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Remote Access > Set Up Remote Management
question: Bagaimana cara mengakses R7000 dari luar rumah sambil membatasi siapa yang boleh masuk?
answer: Aktifkan Remote Management dan batasi Allow Remote Access By hanya ke alamat IP luar yang diperlukan.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Change the NTP Server
question: Bagaimana cara mengganti layanan waktu yang digunakan R7000?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Administration > NTP Settings, pilih server waktu pilihan, isi alamatnya, lalu Apply.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet
question: Bagaimana cara membuka file USB di R7000 ketika saya sedang tidak di rumah?
answer: Dari komputer jauh, gunakan nama Dynamic DNS atau alamat port internet router. Setelah itu file dapat diakses melalui FTP sesuai hak akses.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Remotely Access a USB Device Using ReadyCLOUD > Create a ReadyCLOUD Account
question: Bagaimana cara membuat akun ReadyCLOUD untuk R7000?
answer: Buka alamat ReadyCLOUD, pilih Sign In > Create Account, isi akun MyNETGEAR, lalu Create.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN Software > Install OpenVPN Software on an iOS Device
question: Bagaimana cara memakai layanan VPN R7000 di iPhone atau iPad?
answer: Aktifkan VPN Service, unduh konfigurasi, pasang OpenVPN Connect dari App Store, lalu impor berkasnya ke iPhone/iPad.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick Tips > Sequence to Restart Your Network
question: Apa urutan yang benar untuk menyalakan ulang modem dan R7000?
answer: Matikan modem dan router, nyalakan modem lebih dulu dan tunggu dua menit, lalu nyalakan router dan tunggu dua menit lagi.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot WiFi Connectivity
question: Wi-Fi R7000 saya lemah atau hilang. Apa yang perlu diperiksa?
answer: Periksa LED/tombol Wi-Fi, apakah nama jaringan disembunyikan, keamanan yang dipilih didukung, dan apakah perangkat terlalu jauh atau terhalang.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Unpack your router
question: Apa saja isi kotak RAX120?
answer: Kotaknya berisi router, adaptor daya, dan kabel Ethernet.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Types of logins
question: Kata sandi mana yang dipakai untuk internet, Wi-Fi, akun NETGEAR, dan pengaturan router?
answer: Login ISP untuk internet, Wi-Fi key untuk jaringan nirkabel, akun NETGEAR untuk registrasi/langganan, dan kata sandi router untuk halaman admin.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Set up an IPv6 pass-through Internet connection
question: Apa fungsi IPv6 pass-through di RAX120?
answer: Pada mode Pass Through, router meneruskan paket IPv6 seperti switch dan tidak memproses header IPv6.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > View or change the WAN settings
question: Pengaturan koneksi internet mana di RAX120 yang perlu digunakan dengan hati-hati?
answer: DMZ dapat melemahkan firewall, respons ping WAN sebaiknya hanya untuk diagnosis, dan MTU diubah hanya bila diperlukan. Pengaturan perlindungan DoS, IGMP, NAT, dan SIP juga tersedia.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Manage reserved LAN IP addresses > Reserve an IP address
question: Bagaimana cara membuat sebuah perangkat selalu mendapat alamat jaringan lokal yang sama di RAX120?
answer: Pada LAN Setup, tambahkan alamat MAC dan alamat dari subnet LAN sebagai Address Reservation, lalu Apply. Perangkat perlu memperbarui lease DHCP.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Change the WiFi password or the WiFi security
question: Apa bedanya kata sandi Wi-Fi dan kata sandi administrator RAX120?
answer: Kata sandi Wi-Fi berbeda dari kata sandi admin. Mode personal memerlukan kunci 8–63 karakter; pilihan keamanan Enterprise memerlukan server RADIUS.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Connect a USB storage device to the router
question: Apa yang perlu saya ketahui sebelum mencolokkan flash disk USB ke RAX120?
answer: Colokkan USB ke port router dan sambungkan dayanya bila perlu. Perangkat dapat memerlukan waktu hingga dua menit; perangkat yang memerlukan driver khusus tidak kompatibel.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Add a network folder on a USB storage device
question: Bagaimana cara membagikan folder dari flash disk USB di RAX120?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > ReadySHARE > Advanced Settings, pilih perangkat USB, tekan Create Network Folder, pilih folder dan nama share, atur Read Access serta Write Access, lalu tekan Apply dan Close Window.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Set up and manage Dynamic DNS > Change the Dynamic DNS settings
question: Bagaimana cara mengubah pengaturan akun Dynamic DNS di RAX120?
answer: Masuk ke routerlogin.net, pilih ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Dynamic DNS, ubah pengaturan akun yang diperlukan, lalu tekan Apply.

section_path: Manage port forwarding and port triggering > Manage port forwarding to a local server > How the router implements the port forwarding rule
question: Saat seseorang membuka situs web, bagaimana RAX120 mengarahkannya ke perangkat yang benar?
answer: Browser mengirim permintaan ke alamat router pada port 80. Router mencocokkan aturan port forwarding, mengubah tujuan ke 192.168.1.33, meneruskan permintaan ke server tersebut, lalu menerapkan NAT pada alamat sumber saat balasan dikirim kembali ke Internet.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot WiFi connectivity
question: Perangkat saya tidak bisa tersambung ke Wi-Fi RAX120. Apa yang perlu diperiksa?
answer: Periksa LED WiFi dan tombol WiFi On/Off, apakah SSID broadcast dinonaktifkan, serta apakah perangkat mendukung WPA, WPA2, atau WPA3 yang dipilih. Untuk sinyal lemah, lihat pengaturan melalui kabel Ethernet, dekatkan perangkat tetapi tetap berjarak minimal 1,8 meter, dan singkirkan penghalang.

section_path: Supplemental Information > Factory settings
question: Apa yang berubah setelah RAX120 dikembalikan ke setelan pabrik?
answer: Reset pabrik memakai tombol Reset minimal tujuh detik. Nilai utama mencakup login admin/password, LAN 192.168.1.1 dengan DHCP aktif pada 192.168.1.2–192.168.1.254, MTU WAN 1500, keamanan WiFi WPA2-PSK (AES), SSID broadcast aktif, dan mode radio sampai 1,2 Gbps pada 2,4 GHz serta 4,8 Gbps pada 5 GHz.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Position your router
question: Mengapa memindahkan RAX50 bisa mengubah jangkauan Wi-Fi?
answer: Jangkauan dipengaruhi ketebalan dan jumlah dinding, access point lain, benda logam atau kaca besar, cermin, akuarium, beton, perangkat listrik, dan posisi router yang terlalu rendah atau tidak berada dalam garis pandang perangkat.

section_path: Connect to the Network and Access the Router > Connect to the router network > Connect to the router WiFi network
question: Bagaimana cara menghubungkan ponsel atau komputer ke Wi-Fi RAX50?
answer: Pastikan router menyala, buka pengaturan WiFi perangkat, pilih SSID yang tercetak pada label router, lalu masukkan network key/password pada label tersebut.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Specify IPv6 Internet connections > Use auto config for an IPv6 Internet connection
question: Bagaimana RAX50 mengatur IPv6 secara otomatis?
answer: Pilih Auto Config pada ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > IPv6. Router mendeteksi alamat IPv6 WAN/LAN, lalu Anda dapat mengisi host atau domain ISP bila diperlukan, memilih DNS dan metode penetapan alamat, serta menentukan filtering Secured atau Open sebelum menekan Apply.

section_path: Control Access to the Internet > Network access control list > Manage allowed devices currently not on the network
question: Bagaimana cara mengizinkan atau memblokir perangkat di RAX50?
answer: Di Security > Access Control buka daftar allowed devices yang tidak sedang terhubung. Add memasukkan MAC address dan nama, Remove from the list menghapus, dan Edit dapat mengubah Access Control menjadi Block atau mengganti nama; tekan Apply untuk menyimpan.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Use Dynamic QoS to optimize Internet traffic management > Enable Dynamic QoS
question: Bagaimana cara membuat RAX50 membagi internet dengan adil saat ada perangkat yang memakai banyak data?
answer: Buka QoS, centang Enable QoS, lalu gunakan Speedtest agar router mendeteksi bandwidth atau pilih pengisian manual untuk kecepatan download dan upload. Tekan Apply setelah nilainya ditentukan.

section_path: Optimize Performance > Use Dynamic QoS to optimize Internet traffic management > Manually update the dynamic QoS database
question: Bagaimana cara memperbarui informasi pengaturan lalu lintas di RAX50?
answer: Masuk ke halaman QoS, pastikan Dynamic QoS aktif bila diperlukan, klik Update Now untuk mengunduh versi terbaru database, lalu tekan Apply.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Manage the router configuration file > Erase the settings
question: Apa yang terjadi jika saya menghapus semua pengaturan RAX50?
answer: Semua pengaturan yang dibuat pengguna dihapus, router kembali ke konfigurasi pabrik, lalu restart sekitar dua menit. Jangan menutup browser, memuat halaman lain, atau mematikan router selama proses berlangsung.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > About VPN connections
question: Apa yang bisa dan tidak bisa dilakukan layanan VPN RAX50?
answer: OpenVPN membuat tunnel client-to-gateway terenkripsi agar laptop dapat mengakses jaringan rumah dari luar. Router menyediakan layanan VPN, tetapi bukan VPN client ke provider eksternal sehingga tidak mengenkripsi trafik antara jaringan rumah dan Internet.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Block VPN client Internet access in the router
question: Bagaimana cara agar pengguna VPN RAX50 hanya bisa mengakses jaringan rumah?
answer: Aktifkan VPN Service, pilih Home Network only pada bagian Clients will use this VPN connection to access, lalu tekan Apply. Dengan pilihan ini VPN tidak memberikan akses ke Internet rumah.

section_path: Manage Port Forwarding and Port Triggering > Manage port forwarding to a local server > Delete a port forwarding entry
question: Bagaimana cara menghapus aturan koneksi lama di RAX50?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Port Forwarding/Port Triggering, biarkan Port Forwarding terpilih, pilih service pada tabel, lalu tekan Delete Service.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot your network using the ping utility > Test the path from a Windows-based computer to a remote device
question: Bagaimana cara menguji apakah RAX50 dapat menjangkau alamat lain?
answer: Dari Run Windows jalankan `ping -n 10 <IP address>` untuk alamat remote seperti DNS ISP. Jika tidak ada balasan, periksa default gateway, perbedaan alamat jaringan, modem kabel/DSL, host name ISP, dan kemungkinan kebutuhan clone MAC address.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Connect to the network > Find and connect to the WiFi network
question: Bagaimana cara menemukan dan tersambung ke Wi-Fi RAXE500?
answer: Pastikan router mendapat daya, cari nama WiFi pada perangkat, pilih SSID yang tercetak pada label router, lalu masukkan password pada label tersebut.

section_path: Connect to the network and access the router > Use a web browser to access the router > Automatic Internet Setup
question: Halaman pengaturan RAXE500 tidak muncul atau pengaturan otomatis gagal. Apa yang bisa dicoba?
answer: Pastikan perangkat terhubung ke port LAN atau WiFi router, Power LED menyala, lalu tutup-buka browser atau hapus cache dan buka routerlogin.net. Jika komputer memakai IP statis, ubah agar memperoleh alamat otomatis; bila tetap gagal, periksa ulang informasi ISP atau hubungi ISP dan dukungan NETGEAR.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage the MTU size > MTU concepts
question: Apa pengaruh pengaturan ukuran koneksi di RAXE500?
answer: Paket dipecah ketika perangkat di jalur memiliki MTU lebih kecil. Nilai umum adalah 1500 untuk Ethernet, 1492 untuk PPPoE, 1472 untuk ping, 1468 untuk sebagian DHCP, 1458 untuk PPPoA, dan 1436 untuk PPTP/VPN; nilai default sebaiknya dibiarkan kecuali dukungan ISP/NETGEAR menyarankan perubahan.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Disable the DHCP server feature in the router
question: Bagaimana cara mematikan layanan RAXE500 yang otomatis memberi alamat kepada perangkat dengan aman?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Setup > LAN Setup, hapus centang Use Router as DHCP Server, lalu Apply. Pastikan ada DHCP server lain; jika tidak, tetapkan alamat IP komputer secara manual agar masih dapat mengakses router.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Enable or disable 20/40 MHz coexistence for the 2.4 GHz radio
question: Apakah RAXE500 bisa mengurangi gangguan dari Wi-Fi sekitar, dan apa kekurangannya?
answer: Coexistence mengurangi interferensi dengan mendukung kanal 20 dan 40 MHz, tetapi dapat menurunkan kecepatan. Jika tidak ada jaringan WiFi lain, fitur dapat dinonaktifkan untuk kecepatan maksimum; pengaturan ini tidak berlaku pada radio 5 GHz.

section_path: Manage Network Settings > Manage Ethernet Port Aggregation to a LAN Device > View or Change the Router Ethernet Port Aggregation Mode
question: Apa saja pilihan untuk menggabungkan dua port jaringan RAXE500?
answer: Disable adalah default dan membuat port 3 serta 4 berdiri sendiri. LACP (IEEE 802.3ad) mengagregasikan keduanya bila perangkat mendukungnya dan merupakan pilihan yang direkomendasikan. Static dipakai hanya bila perangkat mendukung static LAG; mode itu harus diaktifkan sebelum perangkat disambungkan.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Monitor Internet traffic
question: Bagaimana cara membuat batas atau peringatan pemakaian data di RAXE500?
answer: Aktifkan Traffic Meter pada ADVANCED > Advanced Setup > Traffic Meter, pilih batas volume download atau dua arah atau batas waktu koneksi, atur counter dan peringatan, lalu tentukan apakah Internet LED berkedip atau koneksi diputus ketika batas tercapai. Statistik dapat diperbarui dengan Refresh.

section_path: Manage Your Router > Set your time zone
question: Bagaimana cara mengatur zona waktu dan penyesuaian daylight saving di RAXE500?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Administration > NTP Settings, pilih zona waktu, centang penyesuaian daylight saving bila wilayah membutuhkannya, lalu tekan Apply.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Add a network folder on a USB storage device
question: Bagaimana cara membagikan folder dari flash disk USB di RAXE500?
answer: Di ADVANCED > USB Functions > ReadySHARE Storage pilih perangkat, tekan Create Network Folder, pilih folder dan nama share, lalu atur Read Access dan Write Access. All tanpa password adalah default; alternatifnya hanya admin yang boleh mengakses.

section_path: Use VPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Set up VPN client Internet access in the router
question: Bagaimana pengguna VPN di RAXE500 juga bisa memakai internet rumah?
answer: Aktifkan VPN Service, pilih All sites on the Internet & Home Network, Apply, lalu unduh konfigurasi untuk Windows atau non-Windows dan salin ke folder client. Trafik Internet melalui VPN rumah dapat lebih lambat daripada koneksi lokal.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick tips > Sequence to restart your network
question: Apa urutan yang benar untuk menyalakan ulang jaringan RAXE500?
answer: Matikan dan cabut modem, matikan router, sambungkan dan nyalakan modem lalu tunggu dua menit, kemudian nyalakan router dan tunggu dua menit lagi.

section_path: Overview > Sync your Orbi satellite with your Orbi router
question: Apa arti warna lampu satellite pada RBK852?
answer: Biru berarti sinkronisasi berhasil dan koneksi baik. Amber berarti koneksi cukup dan satellite sebaiknya didekatkan. Magenta berarti satellite perlu dicabut, dipindah lebih dekat, lalu dicoba lagi; jika tetap gagal, tekan Sync pada router dan satellite dalam waktu dua menit.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage an IPv6 Internet connection > Specify IPv6 Internet connections
question: Bagaimana cara memilih jenis koneksi IPv6 yang tepat di RBK852?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Advanced > IPv6 dan pilih tipe yang sesuai. Jika tidak yakin, gunakan Auto Detect; gunakan Auto Config bila koneksi bukan PPPoE, DHCP, fixed, tetapi tetap IPv6. Pilihan lain yang didokumentasikan mencakup 6to4, 6rd, pass-through, fixed, DHCP, dan PPPoE.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manage an IPv6 Internet connection > Set up an IPv6 PPPoE Internet connection
question: Bagaimana cara mengatur koneksi IPv6 yang memakai login provider di RBK852?
answer: Pilih PPPoE pada halaman IPv6, masukkan login, password, dan service name ISP bila ada, pilih DNS dan address assignment, opsi RIPng/interface ID bila diperlukan, lalu Apply. Mode Always On mencoba menyambungkan kembali bila koneksi terputus.

section_path: Control Access to the Internet > Set up security event email notifications
question: Bagaimana RBK852 bisa mengirim email tentang kejadian keamanan?
answer: Di ADVANCED > Security > E-mail aktifkan Turn Email Notification On, isi alamat email, SMTP server dan port, kredensial bila perlu, lalu atur alert segera atau jadwal log sebelum Apply. Jika alamat atau SMTP kosong, log dan alert tidak dikirim.

section_path: Specify Network Settings > Manage the WAN preference for Orbi router model RBR860 > Set up Internet port aggregation for Orbi router model RBR860
question: Apa yang diperlukan untuk menghubungkan dua jalur antara modem dan RBR860?
answer: Modem harus mendukung LACP. Aktifkan WAN aggregation (10 Gbps + 1 Gbps, LACP-IEEE802.3ad) pada Internet Setup, lalu sambungkan port Internet 10G dan Ethernet port 1 router ke dua port Ethernet modem.

section_path: Specify Network Settings > Manage custom static routes > Set up a static route
question: Bagaimana cara memberi tahu RBK852 agar mengirim data ke jaringan lokal lain?
answer: Buka ADVANCED > Advanced > Static Routes, klik Add, isi nama, tujuan dan subnet mask, gateway, lalu pilih Active dan Private bila perlu sebelum Apply. Gateway harus berada pada segmen LAN yang sama; untuk satu host gunakan mask 255.255.255.255.

section_path: Mantain and Monitor Your Network > Check your Internet bandwidth
question: Bagaimana cara memeriksa kecepatan internet dari RBK852?
answer: Masuk ke orbilogin.com, pilih Speedtest, lalu tekan Take a Speedtest. Halaman menampilkan kecepatan download dan upload Internet.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Use VPN to access your Internet service at home > Block VPN client Internet access in the router
question: Bagaimana cara mencegah pengguna VPN di RBK852 memakai internet rumah?
answer: Aktifkan VPN Service, pilih Home Network only pada pilihan akses client, lalu Apply. Pengaturan default ini menghalangi VPN client memakai layanan Internet rumah.

section_path: Customize Internet Traffic Rules for Ports > Manage port forwarding to a local server > Set up port forwarding to a local server
question: Bagaimana cara membuat koneksi dari luar menjangkau server di jaringan RBK852?
answer: Tentukan layanan/aplikasi, pastikan server memiliki IP lokal tetap, buka Port Forwarding / Port Triggering, pilih Port Forwarding, buat atau pilih nama layanan, masukkan IP server serta port/protokol yang diperlukan, dan Apply.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Quick tips > Sequence to restart your network
question: Apa urutan menyalakan ulang RBK852 yang benar?
answer: Matikan dan cabut modem, matikan router, nyalakan modem dan tunggu dua menit, kemudian nyalakan router dan tunggu dua menit lagi.

section_path: Troubleshooting > Troubleshoot your network using the ping utility > Test the path from your computer to a remote device
question: Bagaimana cara menguji jalur dari komputer melalui RBK852 ke alamat lain?
answer: Setelah jalur LAN benar, jalankan `ping -n 10 <IP address>` dari Windows Run untuk alamat remote seperti DNS ISP. Jika tidak ada balasan, periksa default gateway, perbedaan network address, koneksi modem, host name ISP, dan kemungkinan clone MAC.

section_path: Hardware Setup > Unpack your router
question: Apa saja isi paket XR500?
answer: Paket berisi router, empat antena, power adapter, dan kabel Ethernet.

section_path: Specify Your Internet Settings > Manually set up the Internet connection > Specify an Internet connection without a login
question: Bagaimana cara mengatur XR500 jika provider internet tidak meminta login?
answer: Buka Settings > Setup > Internet Setup, biarkan Does your Internet connection require a login? pada No, isi account/host atau domain bila diperlukan, pilih pengaturan IP, DNS, dan MAC yang sesuai, lalu Apply dan uji koneksi.

section_path: Customize Quality of Service Settings and Optimize Gaming > Manage bandwidth allocation > Prevent network congestion with Anti-Bufferbloat
question: Bagaimana XR500 membantu ketika satu perangkat memakai internet terlalu banyak?
answer: Fitur ini membatasi persentase maksimum bandwidth total yang boleh dipakai perangkat intensif bandwidth sehingga bandwidth tetap tersedia untuk perangkat lain dan antrean atau delay akibat kemacetan berkurang.

section_path: Customize Quality of Service Settings and Optimize Gaming > Manage traffic prioritization > Prioritize traffic for a device and view prioritization information
question: Bagaimana XR500 membantu mengurangi lag saat jaringan sedang sibuk?
answer: Router dapat menempatkan trafik perangkat dan layanan ke bagian depan antrean agar lag berkurang. Prioritas berlaku untuk trafik keluar dan masuk, dan halaman menampilkan jumlah paket upload/download yang diprioritaskan serta status prioritas otomatis.

section_path: Manage the Router’s Network Settings > Manage reserved LAN IP addresses > Change a reserved IP address
question: Bagaimana cara mengubah alamat lokal yang sudah dicadangkan di XR500?
answer: Di Settings > Setup > LAN Setup pilih radio button entri, klik Edit, ubah pengaturannya, Apply pada halaman Address Reservation, lalu Apply lagi pada LAN Setup untuk menyimpan perubahan.

section_path: Manage the Router’s WiFi Settings > Configure WPA/WPA2 enterprise WiFi security
question: Apa yang diperlukan untuk keamanan Wi-Fi gaya kantor di XR500?
answer: Jaringan WiFi harus dapat mengakses server RADIUS karena mode Enterprise memakai RADIUS untuk Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting. Saat mengubah jaringan utama, gunakan koneksi kabel agar tidak terputus.

section_path: Share USB Storage Devices Attached to the Router > Approve USB devices
question: Bagaimana cara mengizinkan hanya perangkat USB yang disetujui di XR500?
answer: Sambungkan perangkat USB, buka Settings > USB Storage > USB Settings, pilih Approved Devices, pilih perangkat pada tabel Available USB Devices, lalu konfirmasi penyimpanannya.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB storage devices through the Internet > Set up FTP access through the Internet
question: Bagaimana cara membagikan penyimpanan USB XR500 melalui internet?
answer: Di Settings > USB Storage > ReadySHARE Storage centang FTP (via internet) dan Apply. Pilih perangkat, Edit, lalu tetapkan Read Access dan Write Access ke admin bila akses ingin dibatasi.

section_path: Use Dynamic DNS to Access USB Storage Devices Through the Internet > Access USB storage devices through the Internet > Use FTP to access storage devices through the Internet
question: Bagaimana cara membuka file USB XR500 dari komputer lain?
answer: Pastikan FTP over Internet sudah disiapkan, lalu gunakan browser untuk mengunduh atau FTP client seperti FileZilla untuk mengunggah. Masukkan `ftp://` diikuti IP Internet router atau nama DDNS; login dapat memakai admin atau guest sesuai hak akses.

section_path: Use OpenVPN to Access Your Network > Install OpenVPN software on a VPN client > Install OpenVPN software on an Android device
question: Bagaimana cara memakai layanan VPN XR500 di Android?
answer: Pasang OpenVPN Connect dari Google Play, buka routerlogin.net dari jaringan router, aktifkan VPN Service, pilih For Smart Phone untuk mengunduh konfigurasi, lalu impor file konfigurasi tersebut ke aplikasi Android.

section_path: Use VPN to Access An External Network > Enable the VPN client in the router and connect to a VPN server
question: Apa yang perlu disiapkan sebelum memakai XR500 dengan VPN komersial?
answer: Router memiliki provider HideMyAss yang sudah didefinisikan, tetapi fitur membutuhkan lisensi dari provider. Aktifkan VPN Client pada Settings > Advanced Settings > VPN Client, pilih provider yang tersedia, dan masukkan kredensial atau pengaturan yang diminta.

section_path: Manage and Customize Internet Traffic Rules for Ports > Manage port triggering for services and applications > Add a port triggering service or application
question: Bagaimana cara membuat game atau aplikasi bisa terhubung melalui XR500?
answer: Buka Settings > Advanced Settings > Port Triggering, klik Add Service, isi nama layanan, pilih user Any atau Single address, pilih TCP atau UDP, lalu masukkan port triggering/incoming dan simpan layanan.
